counterfactual_missing_items: No histopathologic description of Peutz-Jeghers hamartomatous polyps with smooth-muscle core
No family history or STK11 germline testing
decisive_items: brownish macules on the hands and feet
multiple type II and III Yamada polyps on atrophic gastric mucosa
numerous sessile and subpedunculated polyps throughout the colon and rectum
response.rationale: R2 uniquely combines characteristic mucocutaneous hyperpigmentation with diffuse upper and lower gastrointestinal polyposis. R1 accounts only for colonic polyps, while R4, R5, and R3 rely on nonspecific diarrhea, weight loss, and malabsorption features without the distinctive polyposis and pigmentation findings.

rejected.why: Nonspecific chronic diarrhea, abdominal pain, and hypoalbuminemia without polyposis or mucocutaneous pigmentation.
Shared diarrhea, abdominal pain, weight loss, and duodenal nodularity, but lacks the characteristic GI polyposis and mucocutaneous macules.
Only watery diarrhea, hypoproteinemia, and zinc deficiency; no polyposis or mucocutaneous features.
